display.purpose: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; hero clamp(64px,6.55vw,96px), weight 500, line-height 1.025, letter-spacing -0.04em. Mobile and intermediate widths use explicit overrides.

headline.purpose: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; generic h2 clamp(42px,4.6vw,68px), weight 500, line-height 1.02, letter-spacing -0.04em. Individual story and visit headings vary.

body.purpose: DM Sans, sans-serif; base 16px, line-height 1.55. Supporting copy uses section-specific sizes and line-heights; mobile copy is commonly 13–14px.

menuTitle.purpose: Fraunces, Georgia, serif in previews, clamp(20px,1.85vw,25px), weight 500. Full-menu item titles use DM Sans, 15px, weight 600, line-height 1.4.

action.purpose: DM Sans, sans-serif; primary button 13px, weight 600; menu filter 14px, weight 600; currencies 11px, weight 700, tabular prices.

shadows.name: main-photograph
shadows.purpose: Separate the largest offset photograph from the paper field.

shadows.name: small-photograph
shadows.purpose: Make the smaller overlapping photograph read as a separate print.

shadows.name: menu-dialog
shadows.purpose: Separate the focused menu task from the underlying page.

shadows.name: mobile-dock
shadows.purpose: Separate fixed quick actions from scrolling content.

shadows.name: visit-map
shadows.purpose: Separate the integrated Google Map from the green visit surface.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared CSS control feedback easing, from --ease-out.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Primary and icon button press feedback; menu controls use 140ms.

motion.name: hero-entry
motion.purpose: GSAP entrance coordinates the first impression, starting from visible content.

motion.name: menu-entry
motion.purpose: Pointer-triggered full-menu dialog entrance; omitted for keyboard and reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove ScrollTriggers and position animation; retain readable content and instantaneous state changes.

motion.name: coffee-ribbon
motion.value: Linear seamless CSS loop; pause offscreen/hidden
motion.purpose: Give the café invitation an ongoing rhythm with an accessible pause control.

motion.name: photo-album-reveals
motion.purpose: Place photos and reveal the story as visitors scroll, while default content stays visible.

motion.name: global-motion-pause
motion.purpose: Respect manual and OS motion preferences; avoid spatial movement in either paused mode.

components.description: Compact USD/LBP selection; prices use tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-currency{display:inline-flex;padding:3px;border:1px solid rgb(25 53 43 / 24%);border-radius:100px}.ds-currency button{min-width:48px;min-height:36px;padding:7px 10px;border:0;border-radius:100px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#19352b);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.035em;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;touch-action:manipulation;transition:background-color 150ms,transform 140ms var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1))}.ds-currency button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink,#19352b);color:var(--paper,#f6f8f3)}.ds-currency button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#245747);outline-offset:4px}.ds-currency button:active{transform:scale(.97)}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-currency button:not([aria-pressed=true]):hover{background:rgb(25 53 43 / 8%)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-currency button{transition:none}.ds-currency button:active{transform:none}}

components.description: Visible border and focus-within ring with a 16px input for mobile typing.

narrative.overview: La Stazione pairs its original red logo with fresh forest-green typography, clean off-white, pale sage, real café photographs, purposeful motion and an integrated Google Map.
keyCharacteristics: Exact La Stazione title case in both wordmarks.
Original forest-green theme refreshed with clean surfaces.
Real photography with lively album motion.
Native scroll, accessible pause and reduced motion.
Interactive Google Map at the verified café location.
